kiel-malente-bungsberg-eutin-hills.title: Kiel · Malente, Bungsberg and Eutin Hills
kiel-malente-bungsberg-eutin-hills.slogan: A 189 km loop out of Plön lake
kiel-malente-bungsberg-eutin-hills.story: The rare Schleswig-Holstein high-point excuse, with lakes around it. The best part sits around Plön lake gate, Bungsberg high point, Eutin lake, while Bad Malente coffee keeps the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel or food hunt. Check the OSM map, Google preview and GPX checkpoint order before departure; they use the same waypoint sequence. Ride it with legal pull-offs, patience through villages and enough daylight to stop without rushing.

scenicChapters.title: Naran → Lulusar Lake
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 68 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Babusar Pass Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it. The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 4173 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Babusar Pass → Chilas
scenicChapters.narrative: 4173 m come off over 68 km at around 10.8%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it — brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.

babusar-pass-road.story: The stops in between: Lulusar Lake and Babusar Pass. The highest point is about 4,150 m. Babusar Pass is open in summer only - check it is open before you set off. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
